organization.name: Kenya Keys
organization.mission: Unlocking Potential Through Education. Kenya Keys is a grassroots organization dedicated to unlocking the potential of bright, motivated students in rural Kenya through education and holistic support.
organization.educational_promise: Providing direct access to quality education by removing financial barriers for every sponsored student.
organization.academic_focus: Fostering a culture of excellence and empowering students to become the next generation of Kenyan leaders.

contact.address: Taru, Kwale County, Kenya (Along Mombasa Highway)

programs.title: Student Scholarship & Sponsorships
programs.description: Sponsoring secondary and post-secondary students with complete academic fees, tuition, and comprehensive mentorship.

programs.title: Health & Hygiene Support
programs.description: Providing sanitary pads and comprehensive menstrual hygiene education to ensure girls never miss a day of school.

programs.title: ICT Integration in Education
programs.description: Delivering e-learning programs, laptop provisions, and competency-based digital literacy training to rural schools.

programs.title: Psycho-Student Mentorship
programs.description: Offering vital social counselling, professional career guidance, and foundational life skills programs.

programs.title: Library & Literacy Support
programs.description: Facilitating high school book donations and resource curation for our Community Education Center library.

programs.title: Schools Infrastructure
programs.description: Constructing classrooms, toilet blocks, student dormitories, and hand-crafting 3-seater desks.

programs.title: Business Skills Training
programs.description: Empowering communities through business mentorship, entrepreneurship, and sustainable livelihood skills.

how_to_help.donate: You can donate to support various programs. The donations help remove financial barriers for students, construct infrastructure, and provide mentorship.
how_to_help.sponsor_a_student: Sponsor a secondary or post-secondary student to provide complete academic fees, tuition, and comprehensive mentorship.
